summary: A labeled number in a raised card, with its change and an optional trend line.

props.name: value
props.description: The number, already formatted, such as `$58,210`.

props.name: change
props.description: The change, already formatted, such as `12.4%`.

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the change went, which picks its arrow.

props.name: trend
props.description: A trend line under the number, oldest value first.

props.name: tone
props.description: Whether the change is good news: `positive` reads green, `negative` red. A rise in churn is `negative` though it goes up.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the card. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: animated
props.description: Rolls the value and the change when they change, only the digits that differ moving. Reduced motion changes them at once.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.
